# 89th Drama League Awards

| venue = The Ziegfeld Ballroom
}}
The 89th Drama League Awards were held on May 19, 2023, recognizing excellence in Broadway and Off-Broadway productions during the 2022–23 season. Nominations were announced on April 25, 2023, with Sweeney Todd, Into the Woods, New York, New York, Topdog/Underdog, ''A Doll's House, Cost of Living and The Sign in Sidney Brustein's Window leading the nominations, with four each. The revival of Into the Woods'' won the most awards of the night, with two including Outstanding Revival of a Musical.
Winners and nominees
The 2022-2023 Drama League Awards nominations were announced on Tuesday, April 25, 2023, by Justin Guarini and Roger Bart. The awards ceremony took place on Friday, May 19, 2023, at the The Ziegfeld Ballroom, hosted by journalist Frank DiLella.Special awards recipients included:
*The Drama Book Shop (Thomas Kail, Lin-Manuel Miranda, Jeffrey Seller, James L. Nederlander) - Contribution to the Theatre Award
*André De Shields - Distinguished Achievement in Musical Theatre
*Lear deBessonet -  Founders Award for Excellence in Directing
*Darin Oduyoye - Gratitude Award
Winners included Leopoldstadt, which received Outstanding Production of a Play; A Doll's House, which won Outstanding Revival of a Play; Into the Woods, which earned Outstanding Revival of a Musical and Outstanding Direction of a Musical for Lear deBessonet; and Some Like It Hot, which won Outstanding Production of a Musical. The Drama League Award for Distinguished Performance was awarded to Annaleigh Ashford for her performance in Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street.
